Been Playing Video Games since I was six, so I know what I want in a game nowadays. and more importantly, when I have found a good game to put over 1000 hours in. I can say with sound confidence that this game has just about everything I could have hoped for. good hoard combat, random map generation every mission, good co-op gameplay, unique classes, and gear/weapons, amazing re-playability, a dev. team that does not seem to only be in it for money and actually cares for the game, and listens to player feedback, great community, and so much more. Single player IS an option in this game, however this game is definitely multiplayer oriented, so if you have friends who are willing to buy it, then you will more likely have a lot of fun. Shenanigan value is high in this game, so expect a lot of goofing off, tomfoolery, etc. both in and out of missions. IMPORTANT NOTE FOR IN GAME CREDITS AND CRAFTING MATERIALS: Almost all of these WILL become obsolete once you acquire all weapons, upgrades, cosmetics, and after promoting each class once. This is my only real gripe with the game after 1116 hours of play. There is nothing of actual use (even if temporary) that credits, and materials (Excluding Barley Bulbs) can offer to you, and your team which is unfortunate, but the gameplay more than compensates for this by offering a healthy balance of well designed combat, and use of tactics in and out of battle, and good old-fooling around. Have yet to get bored of this game at all, and the Developers seem to be the same way in regards to making more content for the fanbase. cant wait to see what the Ghost-Ship Crew think of next, and eagerly await the new weapons, and over clock update (I forget the number of said update) Absolutely amazing game, never seen anything else as good as this one.
